entities.name: UE request type
entities.description: Information element included by the UE when requesting release of NAS signalling connection or rejecting paging request from the network.

entities.name: MUSIM UE condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE is a MUSIM UE that requests release of NAS signalling connection or rejects paging request.

entities.name: Release NAS signalling connection
entities.description: Property where the UE requests release of the NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Reject paging request
entities.description: Property where the UE rejects the paging request from the network.

relations.description: The UE request type IE is included when the MUSIM UE condition is met.
MUSIM UE condition establishes the property of releasing NAS signalling connection.
MUSIM UE condition establishes the property of rejecting paging request.
